notes.title: 【UPDATE】Ver1.3.0 Realese!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Abyss Seeker development team.



Thank you for playing "ABYSS SEEKER: What Do You See at the End of the Abyss?" on a regular basis.



Today, we have released the major update Ver1.3.0 "HELL".
This update includes the addition of high-difficulty dungeons and a new "MEMORY" feature that reveals the background story of ABYSS SEEKER,
providing new content for those who have already completed the previous version.



With the implementation of the final boss and the ending,
the story of ABYSS SEEKER now reaches its conclusion.
We hope you will enjoy the finale!



Below are the details of the update.



 
◆New Dungeon Floors Added:
New layers have been added beyond Abyss Floor 10.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/7973ed7f9de6d6d509eff158983f404e98fe981a.png"]

In these new areas, you'll face even harsher dungeons, including battles where two bosses appear at once.

You can challenge the Dead Zone "Deep Layer One" after clearing Abyss Floor 10.




◆Final Boss & Ending Added:
By clearing the Dead Zone "Deep Layer Five", the "Chamber of Truth" will appear.

Defeating the boss in the Chamber of Truth will trigger the ending sequence.




◆New Skills Added:
New skills have been introduced for the first time in ABYSS SEEKER.

They can be purchased and equipped via the Shop.



・Grimoire Plus I

Start the search with the number of grimoires you can carry increased by 1.




◆New Artifacts Added：
New artifacts have also been added for the first time in ABYSS SEEKER.

They appear in treasure chests after being purchased in the Shop.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/11a0752b44868fecf21a84e454a0e29c4ef2312d.png"]

・EXPANSION BRACE IV

Increase the number of side book slots by 1.




◆"MEMORY" Feature Added:
New story entries related to "Memories" will unlock upon meeting certain conditions.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/64fc61250c48c856fd622ec6899608c4e8c85186.png"]




◆Difficulty Adjustments per Floor:：
Enemy spawn counts and other factors have been adjusted to reduce overall difficulty.




◆Shopkeeper Graphics Updated：
The shopkeeper’s graphics have been enhanced to higher quality.

The shopkeeper now bows after purchases.

Under certain conditions, the shopkeeper’s appearance will change.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/09c8fb2ccb0219882c6a82788c87589eec3f7b13.png"]




◆Experience Gem Optimization (Performance Improvements):
Increased the pickup radius for experience gems.

Reduced the number of experience gems dropped per enemy (total EXP remains unchanged).

Larger gems will appear once a certain threshold is reached.





Fixed an issue where confirmation key settings would reset.

Fixed a bug where connecting an unsupported controller would cause the Options screen to become unresponsive.



Thank you for your continued support of ABYSS SEEKER!

notes.title: 【UPDATE】Ver1.2.0 Realese!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Abyss Seeker development team.
We have released Update Ver.1.2.0.



◆ New Character: "Pentas P (Prototype) 24" has been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/5f987023e6fd58c0af06d7106e0fb4e874afceb1.png

[Character Description]
The "seventh" seeker found at the bottom of the great abyss.
She was once an explorer from the Mechanized Nation and a prototype of the Pentas Series,
 a line of mechanical soldiers designed specifically for the conquest of the Sky Fortress. 
As her name suggests, she was the 24th unit in the series.

However, the prototype models had inherent design flaws, 
and these issues became apparent with her unit.
As a result, before she could even be deployed for the Sky Fortress mission, 
she was deemed a failure and discarded into the depths of the abyss by the nation.

Although Pentas P24 was nothing more than scrap, she somehow reactivated.
The reason for this remains unknown.
It is unclear if the term "alive" is appropriate for her, but a large portion of her memories have been lost.

※ Pentas P24 becomes available for use after clearing the Deep Abyss - Layer 5: Abyssal Ruins.

◆ New Grimoire Added:
The following new Grimoire makes its first appearance in Abyss Seeker.
It can be purchased from the Shop for use.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/52a3b316cabaded880a63b9e2b73d4e4e6a0f885.png
・PLASMA SHOT

◆ New Artifact Added:
The following new Artifact makes its first appearance in Abyss Seeker.
Once purchased from the Shop, it will start appearing in treasure chests.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/c943acde928d2929abac9664fd51b7ec8e139407.png
・PLASMA CHARGER



◆ Character Adjustments:
With the addition of a new character, balance adjustments have been made to existing characters.
Details are as follows:

◆ Alcea (Initial State)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/8cbb74918cbf86d09134a9ffa1b5767c66552e0e.png
HP: 4 → 5 (Increased)
Bombs: 3 (No change)
Starting Artifact:
MAGIC SHIELD (Added)

◆ Pentas P24 (Initial State)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/2661193ffdb86edbb0938b5bcccdbe827573d455.png
HP: 4
Bombs: 5
Starting Artifact:
PLASMA CHARGER

※ Normally, the MAGIC SHIELDand PLASMA CHARGER can be obtained from treasure chests after purchasing them in the Shop. However, when using the respective characters, they will start with these artifacts already equipped.
For example, if you want to obtain the Magic Shield while using Pentas P24, you will need to purchase it from the Shop first.

Thank you for your continued support of Abyss Seeker!

notes.title: [MAJOR UPDATE] Ver1.1.0 "CHAOS" Released!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Abyss Seeker development team.

Thank you for playing "ABYSS SEEKER: What Do You See at the End of the Abyss?" on a regular basis.

Today, we have released the first major update for ABYSS SEEKER, Ver1.1.0 "CHAOS."
This update introduces various new elements in addition to the existing gameplay, ensuring that even those who have already completed the previous version can enjoy fresh content.
We hope you will give it a try!

Below are the details of the update.



◆ New Grimoires Added:
The following new Grimoires, appearing for the first time in "ABYSS SEEKER," have been added.
They can be purchased from the "Shop" and used in-game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/b68c146b69a52b2b7585691d81f940011d22e776.png

・HUMMING BIRD
・WHIRL WIND 
・DECELERATE

◆ New Artifacts Added:
The following new artifacts, appearing for the first time in "ABYSS SEEKER," have been added.
They will appear in treasure chests after being purchased from the "Shop."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/676d1884abe9cdc8d91aac76cb392ecbb9086a2a.png

・Magic Shield
・Highpoweredbombs
・HidenOfDodge4

◆ New Dungeon Floors Added:
New floors have been added beyond Abyss Layer 6.
On these new floors, you will face even more challenging waves and bosses.
※Abyss Layer 6 becomes available after clearing Abyss Layer 5.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/a2b281fe6b6a14581d7b94a4c05c6e27d8fc02cd.png

◆ Risky Side Books Added:
The following "Risky Side Books" will appear in treasure chests from Abyss Layer 6 onwards.
※Risky Side Books do not need to be purchased from the "Shop."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/0ba47fbc4cd968fd27cb9f458c0b6235256cdb22.png

・FINAL WEAPON
・WAVE SPELL
・SELF-DECOMPOSITION
・DELAY SPELL
・RIGHT SPELL
・LEFT SPELL
・COIN TOSS SPELL
・GRAVITY SPELL
・DOUBLE EDGE SPELL
・BLAZING SUN
・LAVA CONVERSION
・DARK SPELL

◆ Risky Artifacts Added:
The following "Risky Artifacts" will appear in treasure chests from Abyss Layer 6 onwards.
※Risky Artifacts do not need to be purchased from the "Shop."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/8dd29f2b81ff19ba88fec9a08f7d79c61d64683e.png

・CORROSIVE FLAME
・BELL OF BLESSING
・LIFE DRAINING ACCELERATOR
・FORBIDDEN PUPPET
・BLOOD STAINED SWORD
・PAYING THE PRICE

◆ Risky Items Added:
The following "Risky Items" will drop from specific enemies appearing in Abyss Layer 6 and beyond.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/bae24d2f4e5d6bd10059ce015a3021b19d8f58f5.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/621ffe5d9a7742e30fcbc0a2d2756e5c49002d71.png

・Rosary of Doom
・Magnetic Orb
・Goblet of Dark Burial
・Borrowed Life

◆ Corrosion Rank System Added:
The Corrosion Rank system introduces various effects throughout the dungeon, influencing gameplay.
Collecting items labeled "Risky" that have corrosion values will increase the Corrosion Rank upon reaching a certain threshold.
As the rank increases, the game becomes more challenging with effects such as "Increased Enemy HP,"
 "Reduced Visibility," and "Increased Enemy Count."

Additionally, the Corrosion Rank will not reset after each run.
A new feature has been added allowing you to reset the Corrosion Rank by spending coins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/df0244c37e0db7ba11d66247ce324b58a38bf72b.png

◆ Malevolent Treasure Chests Added:
From Abyss Layer 6 onwards, there is a chance that Malevolent Treasure Chests will appear.
All choices in these chests will consist of Risky Items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/e7ecaccaa1bc5d40a2a63812304b96a39f19049a.png

◆ New Item-Dropping Enemies Added:
In addition to the existing enemies that drop hearts,
 new enemies have been added that drop coin bags, bombs, or random Risky Items.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/eba4e8c8d662a0deb03476dc4ab03a2b2fe11ea6.png

◆ "TIPS" Added to the Pause Menu:
Previously viewed tutorials can now be reviewed under "TIPS."

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/53cbe5d0e57d98a9fe42b7c063707ef2a111982d.png

◆ New Tutorials Added:
New tutorials explaining the additions in Ver1.1.0 have been implemented.
These will be displayed at the appropriate times during gameplay.

◆ Inventory Screen Added:
A new "ITEM" tab has been added to the inventory screen.



◆ Enemy Arrow Indicators Added and Adjusted:
When enemies are off-screen, the following indicators have been added or adjusted:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45259002/9b9930d9003e9d58d779902bbb3eeace5a328c2f.png

◇ Additions:
Bosses are now indicated with a large red arrow.
Enemies that drop items are now indicated with a blue arrow.

◇ Adjustments:
Only specific enemies will be indicated with a yellow arrow.


Thank you for your continued support of ABYSS SEEKER.

notes.title: 【UPDATE】Ver1.0.1 Realese!
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the Abyss Seeker development team.
We have released version 1.0.2 with the following updates:

Fixes:

Bug fix for level-up and death occurring simultaneously:Fixed an issue where the chest selection would be displayed when death and level-up happened at the same time.

Bug fix for shield not respawning:Fixed an issue where shields would not respawn when the "Arcane Compression" sidebook was equipped and the mana capacity dropped below 100.


Adjustments:

Movement speed adjustment for Alsea:The initial movement speed of Alsea has been increased, making movement smoother and more comfortable.

Adjustment for Grimoire "Blade & Shield":Increased range and power, but the mana consumption has slightly increased.

Adjustment for Grimoire "Claymore":Increased power, fire rate, and penetration, but mana consumption has slightly increased.

Adjustment for Grimoire "Shield Bash":The power and mana recovery rate have increased, but the firing speed has slightly decreased.

Adjustment for shields:When a shield is destroyed, mana regeneration increases, but the mana cost for blocking enemy projectiles with the shield has increased.

Thank you for your continued support of ABYSS SEEKER!
